cards.card_text: He also kills the Judeans and the Chaldeans who were with Gedaliah at Mizpah.
cards.verse_text: In the seventh month, however, Ishmael son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, who was a member of the royal family, came with ten men and struck down and killed Gedaliah, along with the Judeans and Chaldeans who were with him at Mizpah.
cards.snippet: …with ten men and struck down and killed Gedaliah, along with the Judeans and Chaldeans who were with him at Mizpah.

cards.card_text: Now comes a man named Joseph, a member of the Council, from the Judean town of Arimathea.
cards.verse_text: He was from the Judean town of Arimathea and was waiting for the kingdom of God.
cards.snippet: He was from the Judean town of Arimathea and was waiting for the kingdom of God.

cards.card_text: After this, Jesus heads out into the Judean countryside with His disciples and spends some time with them there.
cards.verse_text: After this, Jesus and His disciples went into the Judean countryside, where He spent some time with them and baptized.
cards.snippet: After this, Jesus and His disciples went into the Judean countryside, where He spent some time with them and baptized.
